name: Willowbrook Remedies
description: Collect fresh leaves from Bramble Sprites in the Whispering Woods.

dialogue.offer: Our healer is running low on Bramble Leaves. Five fresh leaves from the Whispering Woods should be enough.
dialogue.in_progress: The Bramble Sprites west of Meadow carry the leaves we need.
dialogue.ready: Those leaves are still green and strong. Let me bundle them for the healer.
dialogue.completed: Willowbrook's medicine stores are healthy again thanks to you.
